title: Abolition Of The Dual System
definition: The Dual System of administration in Bengal, established by Robert Clive in 1765, separated the 'Diwani' (revenue collection) and 'Nizamat' (police and judicial administration) functions. The abolition of this system in 1772 by Warren Hastings marked the direct assumption of administrative responsibility by the British East India Company.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial microtopic for Modern Indian History (GS Paper I). Frequently tested in Prelims regarding the chronologies of Robert Clive and Warren Hastings, and in Mains regarding the systematic exploitation, economic drain, and structural transformation of Indian administration under Company rule.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of the Dual System and its termination.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and economic dimensions of Bengal's administration.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions regarding Governor-Generals and administrative acts.
